title: Creating Your First Tailwind CSS Page knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which principle is most useful when applying Creating Your First Tailwind CSS Page?
options: It runs all utility classes as JavaScript in the browser.
the installed package and build-tool integration must match the documented workflow
It removes the need to understand HTML semantics, the CSS cascade or browser behavior.
It makes every interface responsive and accessible without testing.
questions.answer_key: the installed package and build-tool integration must match the documented workflow
questions.explanation: Creating Your First Tailwind CSS Page is best understood through the syllabus topics: Building a basic HTML page, Applying typography and color utilities, Adding spacing and borders. Choose the technique deliberately and verify the result.

questions.prompt: Which workflow is strongest when working with creating your first tailwind css page?
options: follow the official install guide for the current toolchain and verify that the stylesheet is imported
Add classes until a screenshot looks acceptable without inspecting generated CSS.
Assume that starting a development server proves every page and state works.
Skip narrow-screen testing because utility-first CSS is automatically responsive.
questions.answer_key: follow the official install guide for the current toolchain and verify that the stylesheet is imported
questions.explanation: A reliable workflow checks generated CSS and the actual interface. Related topics include: Building a basic HTML page, Applying typography and color utilities, Adding spacing and borders, Building a simple card.

questions.prompt: Which common mistake should you avoid when applying creating your first tailwind css page?
options: Document intended behavior and test representative content.
Use the official documentation for version-specific behavior.
Check keyboard states where controls are involved.
mixing incompatible v3 and v4 setup instructions can prevent styles from compiling
questions.answer_key: mixing incompatible v3 and v4 setup instructions can prevent styles from compiling
questions.explanation: Good styling work is verified, version-aware and tested with realistic content and input methods.
